name: Netflix

L4.dsaDepth: Heavy - algorithmic coding plus architectural thinking even at mid-level, since Netflix hires few juniors
rounds: Technical screen(s): live coding, data structures and algorithms
Onsite loop: further coding plus a system-design/architecture discussion (microservice ownership, scalability, low-latency, observability)
extraTopics: Explaining architectural trade-offs even at a "mid" level, since Netflix skews senior

L5 Senior.dsaDepth: Heavy - coding plus full system design; this is the level most candidates are actually evaluated against
rounds: Onsite: coding, system design (micro-service ownership, continuous delivery), a data-modeling round for some tracks, and a values/culture interview
extraTopics: Cross-team leadership and roadmap influence at this level and above
Micro-service architecture and observability for rapid troubleshooting

L6 Staff.dsaDepth: Moderate - technical scope and organisational impact weigh more than raw coding speed
rounds: Similar loop shifted toward staff-level scope: architecture, mentorship, cross-team influence

ladder.title: Software Engineer (entry)
ladder.notes: Netflix hires very few at this level - rarely uses junior titles

ladder.title: Senior Software Engineer
ladder.notes: Where most Netflix engineers sit; historically the company used one flat "Senior Software Engineer" title for 5 to 20 years of experience
